project_type: GPU benchmark harness with EC2 Spot infrastructure (bash + Python)
build_system: No formal build system; bash scripts with AWS CLI for deployment
test_framework: bash -n syntax validation for shell scripts; Python: standard unittest/pytest for Lambda
build_command: bash -n infra/lambda/capacity_poller/handler.py is not applicable; python3 -c 'import ast; ast.parse(open("infra/lambda/capacity_poller/handler.py").read())' for syntax check
verification_instructions: 1. Validate Python syntax of Lambda handler. 2. Run deploy script. 3. Verify Lambda exists and is scheduled. 4. Do a test invocation.
setup_instructions: AWS CLI is already authenticated (account 077090643075, us-east-1). Python 3 available on host.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. AWS CLI authenticated. No Docker needed for Lambda (zip deployment). User wants instances NOT to self-terminate (SELF_TERMINATE=false) so they can SSH in if problems arise. Logs must be preserved for sandbox monitoring.
contribution_requirements: Branch: harden-ec2-bench-runner. Commit and push when done.
key_patterns: 1. launch-bench-ec2.sh renders env prelude + bootstrap into user-data, uploads to S3 if >16KB. 2. AMI resolved via SSM param /aws/service/deeplearning/ami/x86_64/base-oss-nvidia-driver-gpu-ubuntu-22.04/latest/ami-id. 3. Instance profile: tpot-bench-ec2-profile. 4. Subnet mapping is per-AZ (verified). 5. Security group: tpot-bench-noingress-sg (fallback to default). 6. Recipe files are bash exports appended to user-data prelude. 7. Spot options: one-time, terminate on interruption. 8. S3 bucket pattern: tpot-bench-results-077090643075-{region}. 9. Block device: 200GB gp3 root. 10. Tags: Project=tpot-benchmark, Name=tpot-bench-{type}.
directory_structure: / - root: README.md, docs/, reports/, results/, scripts/, tests/. scripts/ contains: bootstrap/bench-bootstrap.sh, launch-bench-ec2.sh, poll-b300-h200.sh, recipes/. infra/ will be created for Lambda deployment.
